description: One podcast episode: the audio (uploaded here, or a URL to your own host) plus everything Apple Podcasts and the open directories read per item. Pair with a Single Object Collection built from the podcast schema for the show itself.

id.label: Episode ID
id.help: A unique ID for this episode. No spaces or special characters. Becomes the item guid, so do not change it once published.

title.label: Title
title.help: The episode title as it appears in apps.

date.label: Publish Date
date.help: Episodes dated in the future are held back from the feed until then.

draft.label: Draft
draft.help: Drafts are left out of the feed.

audio.label: Audio File
audio.help: Upload the episode audio to host it here — MP3 is the safe choice, and Total CMS counts every listen. Leave empty and fill in Audio URL to host it elsewhere.

audioUrl.label: Audio URL
audioUrl.help: Used only when no file is uploaded above: the address of the episode audio on your own host or bucket. Not counted by Total CMS.

audioLength.label: Audio Size (bytes)
audioLength.help: Only for an Audio URL: the file size in bytes, which apps use for download progress. Uploaded files report it automatically.

duration.label: Duration (seconds)
duration.help: Length of the episode in seconds. Apps use it for progress bars; leave at 0 if unknown.

episode.label: Episode Number
episode.help: Optional. Apps show it and use it for ordering serial shows.

episodeType.label: Episode Type
episodeType.help: Full is a normal episode. Trailers and bonus episodes are labelled as such in apps.

content.label: Show Notes
content.help: The full show notes. HTML is carried into the feed; apps render a plain-text version where they must.

summary.label: Summary
summary.help: Optional short plain-text description. When blank, the show notes are used with formatting stripped.

art.label: Episode Art
art.help: Optional square artwork for this episode, JPG or PNG. The show's cover is used when blank.

explicit.label: Explicit
explicit.help: Override the show-level setting for this episode.

transcript.label: Transcript
transcript.help: Optional. Upload an SRT, VTT, JSON or text transcript; apps that support transcripts fetch it from here.

transcriptUrl.label: Transcript URL
transcriptUrl.help: Used only when no transcript file is uploaded: a link to a transcript hosted elsewhere.

chapters.label: Chapters
chapters.help: Optional. Upload a Podcast Index chapters JSON file.

chaptersUrl.label: Chapters URL
chaptersUrl.help: Used only when no chapters file is uploaded: a link to a chapters JSON file hosted elsewhere.

created.label: Date Created
created.help: The date the episode was created

updated.label: Date Updated
updated.help: The date the episode was last updated
